roadmap_revision.reason: A6 was split before execution; A6a was split because the signed A5 APK predates D4a/D4b; A6a2 is split again because fully automatic no-routine-ADB verification spans native self-check, browser DAL/fallback evidence, PWA correlation, signed rebuild, and real-device acceptance and cannot reliably fit in one 18-minute checkpoint.
roadmap_revision.a6a1: rebuild and cryptographically verify the current signed release candidate
roadmap_revision.a6a2b: browser Digital Asset Links relationship validation plus observable Custom Tab fallback
roadmap_revision.a6a2c: automatic PWA launch handshake, Supabase correlation, and deterministic verdict rules
roadmap_revision.a6a2e: real-device automatic acceptance from Supabase evidence; routine path requires no ADB
roadmap_revision.automatic_verification_policy: Normal A6a2 path must not require user-run ADB or screenshots. Public Android/browser evidence is evaluated first. Callback timeout/unknown is INCONCLUSIVE, never guessed. ADB is a last-resort fallback only after automatic evidence is exhausted.
roadmap_revision.privacy_rule: Use synthetic/non-sensitive test data only; probe IDs must be random technical IDs with no user data; keep signing key/password outside Git and logs; diagnostics collect technical metadata only.

browser_dal_and_fallback.provider_binding: Uses the actual Android Browser Helper TWA provider package selected by TwaLauncher and binds Custom Tabs validation to that provider.
browser_dal_and_fallback.dal_relationship: Requests RELATION_HANDLE_ALL_URLS validation for https://linkpas.vercel.app and preserves callback true, callback false, and no-callback/unavailable evidence as distinct states.
browser_dal_and_fallback.timeout_policy: A missing browser callback times out to inconclusive; timeout is never promoted to false or pass.
browser_dal_and_fallback.fallback_observability: Wraps the existing Android Browser Helper fallback strategy and emits fallback_invoked evidence before delegating to the actual fallback launch.
browser_dal_and_fallback.diagnostics: Beta-only native_twa_evidence is sent through the existing best-effort diagnostics transport without changing normal user-facing workflow.
browser_dal_and_fallback.privacy: Evidence contains bounded technical provider/relationship/fallback state only; no user content, clipboard data, affiliate-link contents, signing material, credentials, or device identifiers are collected.
